question.text: A Clearing Member may choose different CCs as its designated CC for:

answer.text: Different business segments, since the choice is made at CM-Segment level
Different clients within the same segment
Different types of securities within the same segment

explanation.text: The Logic: A CM may choose a different CC as its designated CC for different business segments because the designated-CC choice is made at the CM-Segment level. The Trap: The flexibility is across business segments, not across clients, trading days, or types of securities within a single segment. Note: Because the designation is at the CM-Segment level, within a single segment a CM has one designated CC at a time, while across segments different CCs can be chosen.
